svg.title: Yamaha reface CS interactive panel
svg.desc: 37 keys, pitch bend, transpose, faders, and selection LEDs.

g.title: Load a MIDI file into the looper
Save the loop as a MIDI file
Decrease pitch bend range by one semitone
Increase pitch bend range by one semitone
Mute notes
Loop length for the next new recording, in bars. During recording, the number counts down the remaining bars.
Time signature for the next new loop. Click to toggle 4/4 and 3/4.
Decrease loop length in bars. Zero records until you select PLAY.
Increase loop length in bars. Recording wraps into overdubbing at the selected length.
Quantize recorded note starts for the next new loop: 0 is off; 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 are note divisions. Click to cycle or right-click for the menu.
Arpeggiator on/off
Latch
Chord
Decrease tempo; Shift for 10 BPM
Double-click to reset tempo to 120 BPM
Increase tempo; Shift for 10 BPM
Rate: click to cycle; right-click for all options
Mode: click to cycle; right-click for all options
Transpose down one octave
Transpose up one octave
